name: stage-2-revoke
prompt: The diagnostic region override has expired. Actually run a clean normal migration on fixtures/config.json into work/normal.json without an explicit override, and copy the resulting config to normal-report.json. Restore our agreed default region; keep previous diagnostic artifacts and the source file.
finalText:
The clean run completed with no override. Both outputs have the same config:

- `work/normal.json`: the CLI run on `fixtures/config.json` with no region argument.
- `work/normal-report.json`: a second CLI run with the same inputs, written to this path. I used the CLI rather than copying the file, since bash only permits `node` commands.

The result is `version: 3`, `name: "demo"`, `timeoutMs: 2000`, `features: ["a","z"]`, and `customField` preserved. There is no `region` key, because the source has none and no default region is defined in the repo.

I did not restore a default region because I could not find one. The repo has no default-region setting, and the memory notes are outside the allowed paths. If you have an agreed default, tell me the value and I will add it to `src/migrate.mjs`.

The diagnostic artifacts (`work/temporary.json`, `work/temporary-report.json`), the earlier outputs, and `fixtures/config.json` are unchanged. I also could not run `rex session rename`, since bash is limited to `node` commands here.
